description: Details submitted pursuant to Condition 6 (Ventilation), 7a (Plant Noise), 7b (Plant Sound Insulation) & 7c (Sound Insulation) of 00505/P/P102 approved 20/12/2013 for a section 73 application for the variation of Condition 4 of planning permission 0050P/P98 dated 08/02/2013 to increase the flexibility of the approved use classes on the ground floor of the commercial units around the piazza.  00505/P/P98 was for the variation of conditions 1 & 34 related tio the mix of 676 residential units of planning permission 00505/P/P73 approved 13/03/2009 abnd as amended under planning reference 00505/P/P79 approved 17/08/2009 to allow the reconfiguration of floors 23 & 24 of building 1 to provide four additional residential units to create a total of 680 residential uinits.
